Review statement: MAJOR — FLT/RDY pull-ups on V5A exceed the NSI6611 rating (≤ VCC1) by 0.2 V at the rail corners; the V5GD-absent state is undefined
Class: Confirmed (round 8 had listed it as P-03, a bench item — wrong: a bench pass cannot waive an absolute maximum)
Verification: NSI6611 DS 1.2: RDY, FLT ≤ VCC1 with no +0.3 V; IN±/RST ≤ VCC1 + 0.3 V. V5A (FS26 LDO2) and V5GD (NCV4276C) can sit 0.2 V apart. Found while fixing it: moving only the four pull-ups leaves RFLTC (V5A) forward-biasing the BAT46 diode-OR into the FLT lines, up to ≈ 68 mV above V5GD.
Action / where: RFLTP1/2, RRDYP1/2 and RFLTC now pull to V5GD, which reaches the card on harness pin 39. Pin 39 was one of nine DGND pins; its only neighbours are DGND (37) and HW_ID (40), so a short is detected or collapses V5GD; it can never stick a safety line. RV5GP 100 k reads an open pin as V5GD absent. A lost V5GD now reads FLT/RDY low: the latch sets, ASC is masked, the eFlexPWM fault forces PWM low and DRV_EN falls. That is SPO, and every card output into the dead domain is low. At the rail corners the IN/EN inputs sit ≤ VCC1 + 0.2 V, inside their +0.3 V rating. §6 gains a V5GD row, and §9 tells a V5GD loss from a pending DESAT. ERC by net and pin. +₹0.3.

The LVC load line is labelled as a MOS-triode bound, not a supplier curve.

Review statement: Parking drain, ≈ 150 mA. The S1 start-up already begins at VDD = 0 V, so no start time is lost. +₹27.6.
